entries.rationale: Adds the canonical verb; bounded listing of the user's staged image locker, metadata only. The namespace is launchpad-neutral on purpose: there is ONE locker, shared by every launchpad, and the previous name (trench__images_list) taught the model that it belonged to Trench, which was never true.

Resource then action, with no plural: this publishes exactly ONE picture per call, so a `_list`-shaped or plural name would misdescribe the operation. `publish` rather than `upload` because the consequence the user consents to is publication, not transfer.
